targets.query: from(bucket: "ntn") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ntn_slice") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "slice_satisfaction") |> group(columns: ["slice_sst"])

from(bucket: "ntn") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ntn_slice") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "slice_served_mbps" or r._field == "slice_demand_mbps") |> group(columns: ["slice_sst", "_field"])

from(bucket: "ntn") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ntn_slice") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "slice_latency_p99_ms") |> group(columns: ["slice_sst"])

from(bucket: "ntn") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ntn_slice") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "slice_latency_breach" or r._field == "slice_reliability_breach") |> sum() |> group(columns: ["slice_sst", "_field"])
